newsitem.title: USA: Sequus to test Doxil for ovarian cancer use.
newsitem.headline: Sequus to test Doxil for ovarian cancer use.

text.p: Sequus Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Wednesday it has begun a series of clinical trials for its drug Doxil, or doxorubicin HC1 liposome injection, for use in ovarian cancer patients.
These studies are part of Sequus's clinical development plan to investigate DOXIL as single-agent therapy in combination therapy for the treatment of ovarian cancer.
DOXIL is a long-circulating liposome formulation of doxorubicin, an anticancer drug. It is sold in the United States by Sequus and is used to treat Kaposi's sarcoma in some AIDS patients.
